Black Polymer Coating: The big reasons behind this is are cost and utility in a battlefield. Polymer coating a gun costs a hell of a lot less than installing wood furniture and is much easier for a manufacturer. The utility behind it is that it is also much more resilient to damage and wear than wood. It's more shock absorbent, weather resistant, overall superior material to wood. It is also much easier to paint and apply camo coatings to if that is required. Polymers can also be much more ergonomic as they can be soft have more grip on them.

Pistol Grips (the main one): Reasoning behind pistol grips on rifles is a matter of ergonomics and some improvement in flexibility. When used as weapons of war, assault rifles and SMGs are meant to be mobile meaning lots of running, climbing, and use on the go. Pistol grips usually allow more hand movement which can help with use on the go. That's why high power rifles and most other non-mobile rifles will usually stick with a regular rifle grip, it just won't really matter all too much either way. Pistol grips also allow for easily exchangeable grip types which can help with comfort, grip, and looks. Foreward grips, the ones that can be installed under the barrel for the foreward hand are also for comfort, can help reduce rifle sway by helping the hand position stay more stable. Not too many criminals take multi-hundred meter shots from a standing position so kind of moot for crime.

Collapsible/ Adjustable Stocks: User comfort once again, simply allows for customizing the stock stick-out so that it can accommodate users of all sizes. Collapsible stocks also allow for easier storage and more comfortable transport. Obviously can help with conceal-ability but hey, why not just carry a pistol at that point which nearly all criminals do anyway.

Barrel shroud: Honestly the stupidest banning in my opinion, the whole point is to provide a guard to prevent you from accidentally touching the hot barrel and burning yourself. Only really used on some SMG and heavier MGs. Kind of helps against crime if you think about it as it makes the rifle marginally heavier and more cumbersome.

During my divorce, my wife wanted me to sell the house that I spent the previous year building every single day. This is at the height of the bubble, so the housing price was inflated by $46k. She wanted $23k from me to keep the house. I agree, and write up a quick contract that says I have unlimited time to pay back the "loan" she gave me because we would both be struggling.

However, I find out through a reliable source, that she's been cheating on me, stealing money out of a retirement account, and hired a lawyer to try to fuck me at every turn. So, I did some side work for an attorney (I'm in IT), and he advised me what to do and say. (Ex and I both "agreed" not to hire attorneys). So, we get divorced, everything is split, and the "loan" still stands.

Fast forward, she wants to buy a house with her new boyfriend. Bank says no because her name is still on our loan. She wants me to refinance without her name on it. Which of course will cost me thousands in closing costs. The bank tells her that she has to sign a quit claim deed, walking away from the house so they can do the refinance. She says she won't. They say don't worry about it, as long as we don't record it with the county and only give it to the bank, she's fine with the $23k I "owe".

Anyway, I have to sign some tax documents at the county and it requires her to be there to sign it. So, we meet up, and I'm playfully teasing her to piss her off. We go up to the county clerk, sign the documents, and asks if there's any other reason she needs to be there. The clerk says no, and she gets up, flips me off and goes "Fuck you Scine!".

The clerk, who works with her, is taken aback. I just shrug and say "See, the anger issues I have to deal with"? So, she leaves, and the clerk asks if there's anything else she can do for me.

I simply say "Yes, can you record this please" and pull out the quit claim deed. Signatures line up, and she's now screwed out of the $23k she thought she was going to get from me for sticking a knife in my back while I was working 2 jobs to put her through college.

She asked about the money about a year later, and I told her what I did. She works in the legal field and knew she was completely screwed. Haven't heard from her since.

The Story of the Taoist Farmer

This farmer had only one horse, and one day the horse ran away. The neighbors came to condole over his terrible loss. The farmer said, "What makes you think it is so terrible?"

A month later, the horse came home--this time bringing with her two beautiful wild horses. The neighbors became excited at the farmer's good fortune. Such lovely strong horses! The farmer said, "What makes you think this is good fortune?"

The farmer's son was thrown from one of the wild horses and broke his leg. All the neighbors were very distressed. Such bad luck! The farmer said, "What makes you think it is bad?"

A war came, and every able-bodied man was conscripted and sent into battle. Only the farmer's son, because he had a broken leg, remained. The neighbors congratulated the farmer. "What makes you think this is good?" said the farmer.
It's all a matter of perspective! That's a brilliant story.
